title: excoecaria laurocerasus
intro: Excoecaria laurocerasus, commonly known as the Poison Tree, is a plant species within the family Euphorbiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Excoecaria laurocerasus include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its potential to act as a cardiovascular protector. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
